changes.summary: Pause scheduled imports without deleting their settings
details: Workspace administrators can pause and resume an import schedule.
Pausing a schedule does not stop an import already running.

changes.summary: Import history moves to cursor pagination
details: The import-history API now returns a next_cursor field.
Offset pagination is deprecated and remains available until the stated migration deadline.

migration.action: Update import-history integrations to send the returned next_cursor as the cursor parameter instead of using offset.

changes.summary: Retried completion webhooks retain their event ID
details: Retries for an import-completed webhook now reuse the original event_id.
Consumers can use that ID to recognize duplicate deliveries; delivery itself is still at least once.

changes.summary: Audit exports rename the actor column
details: The audit export actor column is renamed to actor_email.
Existing parsers that require the old header are affected.
An offline history viewer is proposed for a future release.

changes.summary: Move staging queue workers to pool cedar
details: Internal staging deployment uses the cedar worker pool.
